edges.notes: axios.post("/api/subspreadit", payload) in a useMutation mutationFn; root-relative, same origin. app/api/subspreadit/route.ts exports POST

axios.patch(`/api/username/`, payload) in a useMutation mutationFn; next.config.js sets no trailingSlash (default false), so the trailing slash gets a 308 that keeps the method and lands on /api/username. app/api/username/route.ts exports PATCH

Server-side axios.get(href) in the link-preview route: href is the request's ?url= query parameter, known only at runtime (a page to preview, normally an external site), and no code in the repo calls /api/link with a fixed URL
axios.patch("/api/subspreadit/post/comment/vote", payload) in a useMutation mutationFn; root-relative. The vote route file exports PATCH

axios.patch(`/api/subspreadit/post/comment/`, payload) in a useMutation mutationFn; trailing slash ⇒ 308 (trailingSlash default false) keeping PATCH, landing on /api/subspreadit/post/comment, whose route file exports PATCH
Reply form: axios.patch(`/api/subspreadit/post/comment/`, payload) in a useMutation mutationFn; trailing slash ⇒ 308 keeping PATCH to /api/subspreadit/post/comment (exports PATCH)
axios.get(`/api/search?q=${input}`) in a useQuery queryFn; query dropped. app/api/search/route.ts exports GET

fetchPosts (useInfiniteQuery's queryFn): axios.get(query), query = `/api/posts?limit=…&page=…` + (subSpreadItName ? `&subSpreadItName=…` : "") built at lines 28-30; either alternative is /api/posts with a query. app/api/posts/route.ts exports GET
axios.patch("/api/subspreadit/post/vote", payload) in a useMutation mutationFn; the post vote route file exports PATCH (line 10, after imports and a constant)
